name: waza-compliance-remediation-transactions
instr:
Let users preview checker-owned remediation for skill-readiness problems and safely apply the automatic portion as a single transaction. Plans should preserve each checker's evidence and distinguish mechanical corrections from issues requiring author judgment. Existing compliance checks remain unchanged when remediation is not requested.

Every ComplianceChecker plan identifies the same checker as its ordinary result, explicitly classifies applicability, and derives actions without downstream reinterpretation. Combined actions are stable by checker order, normalized slash-separated target, and action identity, and every targeted action records the target content it was planned against. ComplianceScoreChecker changes only unambiguous writable frontmatter, EvalSuiteChecker creates only at the workspace-aware location it searches, and neither disturbs existing authored content. ScopeReductionChecker and TokenBudgetChecker provide evidence-based manual guidance without editing prose, while TokenLimitsChecker provides separately preconditioned per-file guidance retaining each resolved limit and pattern. Applying automatic actions is atomic: stale input, failure, or interruption leaves all existing and newly created targets as they were, while pre-commit cancellation writes nothing and a rolled-back plan remains retryable. Preview and application expose identical ordered plan semantics through text, JSON, and Sensei, including isolated per-skill reports in discovery order, while or
